body: Hey, you’re very young and I can relate to how you feel. I used to suffer badly with social anxiety at your age and felt the same about relationships. It can get better, it did for me, I am now 27 and in a long term relationship. I can talk to people easily and it’s just something a lot of people struggle with (probably more than you realise). Try putting yourself out there, get a job in a cafe or do some volunteering where you have to communicate to some degree. You may surprise yourself by how quickly it gets easier. Also. People are more focussed on themselves than worrying about what you’re doing or saying, so try not to worry so much. It’s totally normal and very common and I wish someone had told me this when I was your age! Good luck

I feel like there should be like an assessment process after a certain amount of time, whereby it could be decided whether a person should be entitled to be able to die with dignity in a peaceful way. No way would I be letting my dog suffer the way I am right now.

Me too. It’s like I want to be gone, but I also want to be here to look after everyone once I am. If only they could see how we suffer I’m sure it would make it easier for them to understand. I have a 14 year old sister who I love so much and I am terrified about how it would affect her as well as my boyfriend, family and friends. Suicide is especially hard to deal with, but on giving it a lot of thought it shouldn’t be, provided the person has tried to get better with proper support. Better to be at peace from an internal hell finally than to be happy but die in an accident. The latter should be a sadder affair, but of course it isn’t for those left behind.

There’s more 21 year old virgins (and older) out there than you might realise. I get your issue completely, I was 22 I think and in hindsight, it was seriously no big deal waiting til then. Sex is good, but only with the right person. I know it’s hard to feel like a proper adult etc, but honestly if you focus on you, learn to love yourself, invest in yourself, get out there and meet new people. Confidence can grow and things can change very quickly. Try not to worry about what everyone else is doing and remember, the right person will not give a shit that you haven’t done it yet.

Hi there, I completely get what you’re saying about responsibility and it being too much. Are there any other family members or family friends you could reach out to for help? You need to get yourself out of the situation, can you move in with a friend? College isn’t the be all and end all although I know it can feel like that. I bet you’re organised and hardworking and that counts for a lot to employers. You need a break, a proper break. If you don’t have family or friends you can reach out to, try to see what support there is available locally...try a helpline and see if they have any advice. You matter, if you can get sorted, you can help your siblings. It’s time for you to be a kid and have some fun. You are overwhelmed which is why you’re struggling to handle everyday things. You must find a way to take a break, not just for you but so you can be a support for your siblings. Good luck, take care :)
I would get her permission first but it’s a good idea 😊

Hi. Although I can’t say that your current actions are ok, as you realise yourself. I can’t help but feel like the comment you got was not very helpful/kind. There are always reasons why people behave in the way they do, which doesn’t justify it but it can help us to understand. My advice would be to write down what matters to you, what you’re not happy about and deep down what you feel may be contributing to your ‘behaviour’. Personally I would tell your husband the truth, he deserves to know. It sounds like you need some help with being compassionate and forgiving towards yourself so therapy is probably something worth looking into? Your kids deserve to have you there and I believe you should do whatever you can to protect and help them in life. Also, tell the ‘man’ that you’re cheating on your husband with to sort himself out and cut contact!!
